summary: Ripple Swell (27-29 Oct) delivered real items: Robinhood RLUSD integration, BNY custody for XRP/RLUSD, OCC trust bank approval and Moody's A2 rating for RLUSD. But XRP itself fell with the market (-2.5% 24h, ~$1.29) and much of the X chatter is outsized price-target hype. Score trimmed from 0.45 as the news is mostly priced and macro is risk-off.
catalyst_note: Swell 27-29 Oct: Robinhood RLUSD, BNY custody, Moody's A2 for RLUSD
